chapter: New Orleans pianists and Clarence Williams
title: Fred Washington, great Storyville pianist
summary: Fred Washington, now paralyzed, influenced Steve Lewis and used chords later called modern.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah, well the piano players that I actually know, they were older than me, but the answer ones that I know who played back in Storyville during those times was Fred Washington, which was a great piano player.
You know, we got to see him when Professor Renette and I went out to California. Yeah. And he's paralyzed now too. Oh yeah? Yeah, his wife has to dress him.
He can't do a thing for himself. Any little thing he has to do, she has to feed him. Oh.

Everything he does. Well he was a great piano player, he was, that's who Steve Lewis adopted his style from Fred Washington. Fred Washington was a great piano player and I'll tell you another piano player who was really good, when I say the great piano player because the different chords that the fellows are making now called modern chords, what Fred Washington was making in those days. He was, that's the kind of piano he was playing.
I believe what you told me once is when he was around nobody else would play. Yeah.
